These two methods are cold (only caller outside Utils is gui MethodDeclaration fallback), so the map lookup vs switch perf is irrelevant. Net −46 lines, behavior-preserving.

In `StringUtils.java`: `getSpecialStringForCodePoint(int)` duplicated the five whitespace escape mappings (`\n \r \t \b \f`) already defined in `escapeWhiteSpaceChar(char)`. Made the latter the single source: `getSpecialStringForCodePoint` keeps only its unique cases (`'`, `"`, `\\`) and delegates the default to `escapeWhiteSpaceChar`. CRITICAL guard: `c <= Character.MAX_VALUE` before `(char) c` cast — a supplementary code point like 0x1000A truncates to 0x000A (`\n`) and would be wrongly escaped otherwise. Behavior-preserving, net −8 lines. (Did NOT touch `notBlank`'s `trim().isEmpty()` → `isBlank()` — NOT equivalent: `\b`-only string trims-empty but is not Character.isWhitespace-blank.)

In `TypeUtils.java` (jadx.core.dex.nodes.utils): (1) `getClassGenerics` — dropped the dead `generics == null ? emptyList : generics` ternary; the guard `clsDetails == null || getTypeParameters().isEmpty()` already NPE's on null and returns on empty, and ClspClass.getTypeParameters() is a stable field getter (defaults to emptyList), so the final branch always returned the non-null list. In `AccessInfo.java` (jadx.core.dex.info): ~18 `isX()` methods each re-inlined `(accFlags & AccessFlags.X) != 0` despite the existing `containsFlag(flag)` helper doing exactly that; routed them all through `containsFlag(AccessFlags.X)` (incl. `isSynchronized` → `containsFlag(SYNCHRONIZED | DECLARED_SYNCHRONIZED)`, equivalent since containsFlag tests "any bit set"). Since `AbstractVisitor.getName()` already does `getClass().getSimpleName()`, all were redundant. Removed across `dex/visitors/`, `dex/visitors/regions/`, `dex/visitors/typeinference/`, `dex/visitors/usage/`, `dex/visitors/rename/`, and `deobf/`. 75 lines deleted. Kept `MethodVisitor` (injects name via constructor) and `DebugChecksPass` (returns `"Checks-for-" + visitorName`).

## Refactor #2 (completed)

Three changes in one commit:
- `JsonBaseMapping` extracted: `JsonClsMapping`, `JsonMthMapping`, `JsonFieldMapping` all duplicated `name`/`alias` fields + getters/setters; pulled up into new `JsonBaseMapping` superclass (~50 lines removed)
- `MethodInfo.calcHashCode()`: narrowed from `public` to `private` (no external callers; only called from constructor)
- `MethodInfo.hasAlias()`: changed `!name.equals(alias)` → `!Objects.equals(name, alias)` for null-safety, consistent with `FieldInfo.hasAlias()`

## Refactor #1 (completed)

Four changes in one commit:
- `ListUtils`: removed unused `mutableListOf(T,T)`, `mutableListOf(T...)`, `concatSetsToList` overloads (dead code, no callers)
- `Utils`: `collectionMap` → delegates to `ListUtils.map`; `first(List)` → `ListUtils.firstOrNull`; `last(List)` → `ListUtils.last`; removed dead `collectionMapNoNull`
- `FileSignature`: **bug fix** — `??` wildcard bytes were stored as 0 and compared without special handling; WEBP/MP4/WAV/M4A magic-byte matching was broken. Fixed using `int[]` with sentinel `-1` for wildcards.
- `XmlGenUtils.getAttrTypeAsString`: replaced repeated `String +=` with `StringBuilder`

lines: Android decompiler codebase. ~1966 Java files across jadx-core, jadx-gui, jadx-cli, jadx-plugins, jadx-commons modules. Java 11 source compatibility, Gradle build (unbuildable without network/cached deps).

In `AccessInfo.java` (jadx.core.dex.info): ~18 `isX()` methods each re-inlined `(accFlags & AccessFlags.X) != 0` despite the existing `containsFlag(flag)` helper doing exactly that; routed them all through `containsFlag(AccessFlags.X)` (incl. `isSynchronized` → `containsFlag(SYNCHRONIZED | DECLARED_SYNCHRONIZED)`, equivalent since containsFlag tests "any bit set"). Also tidied 3 raw masks in `makeString`: STRICT/SUPER → containsFlag, ENUM → isEnum(). Left `isPackagePrivate` (`& VISIBILITY_FLAGS == 0`, combined-mask == 0, not a single magic-constant) and the VISIBILITY_FLAGS/remove bit-ops alone. Behavior-identical, 22 lines rewritten.

+In `RegionUtils.java`: removed dead `getFirstInsn(IContainer)` and `getFirstBlock(IContainer)` (−44 lines). Verified repo-wide: each was referenced only by its own declaration + self-recursive call; the external `getFirstInsn` hits all belong to `BlockUtils.getFirstInsn`/`IfCondition.getFirstInsn` (different classes), and `getFirstBlock` matches were `getFirstBlockNode` (the live equivalent, kept). No imports became unused (IBlock/InsnNode/IBranchRegion/IRegion/JadxRuntimeException/List all still used by getLast*/hasExitBlock). Matches what a prior worktree found (see refactor #23 note).

I reviewed `RegionUtils` and removed dead code.

## What I changed (`jadx-core/.../jadx/core/utils/RegionUtils.java`)

Removed two unreachable public methods, `getFirstInsn(IContainer)` and `getFirstBlock(IContainer)` (~44 lines). Each was referenced **only** by its own declaration and its single self-recursive call — no other callers anywhere.

## How I verified they're dead
A repo-wide grep for both names turned up only unrelated matches:
- The external `getFirstInsn` hits are all `BlockUtils.getFirstInsn(IBlock)` and `IfCondition.getFirstInsn()` — different classes with different signatures.
- Every `getFirstBlock` match was actually `getFirstBlockNode` (substring overlap) — which is the *live* equivalent and remains in place, used by `SwitchOverStringVisitor`.

A follow-up grep for the qualified `RegionUtils.getFirstInsn` / `RegionUtils.getFirstBlock` returned nothing. The sibling `getLastInsn`/`getLastBlock`/`getLastInsnWithBlock` methods (which *do* have external callers) are untouched.

## Safety
No imports became unused — `IBlock`, `InsnNode`, `IBranchRegion`, `IRegion`, `IContainer`, `JadxRuntimeException`, and `List` are all still referenced by the remaining methods. Braces balanced (176/176). Verified by inspection since the module isn't buildable here (no network/cached deps).

This also removes a maintenance trap: `getFirstInsn`/`getFirstBlock` were near-duplicates of `getLastInsn`/`getLastBlock`, so there was dead code shadowing the live code paths.

Working tree now has uncommitted changes across five files (`Utils.java`, `StringUtils.java`, `TypeUtils.java`, `AccessInfo.java`, `RegionUtils.java`). Still not committed — let me know if you'd like them committed (individually or together).
